_about: Machine-readable vocabulary of every AdvancedMD / Stedi API call the project has captured. ONE entry per call. docs/postman_effinger_amd.json is GENERATED from this file by tools/mirror/postman_build.py — edit here, never the collection. Never store a token, password, key, patient name or member number in this file.

variables.token: AMD usercontext token from login (never stored)

calls.name: Login step 1 — partnerlogin (returns webserver redirect)
calls.body: <ppmdmsg action="login" class="login" msgtime="{{msgtime}}" username="POI0712" psw="{{amd_password}}" officecode="152563" appname="TEMP"/>
calls.description: ONE ATTEMPT ONLY — a second failed login locks POI0712 and kills the Claimocity feed. Response carries webserver="..."; repeat the same body against <webserver>/xmlrpc/processrequest.aspx to get <usercontext>TOKEN</usercontext>. Token = {{token}} everywhere else.

calls.name: Login step 2 — webserver (returns usercontext token)
calls.body: <ppmdmsg action="login" class="login" msgtime="{{msgtime}}" username="POI0712" psw="{{amd_password}}" officecode="152563" appname="TEMP"/>
calls.description: Same body as step 1, posted to the webserver returned by step 1. success="1" + <usercontext> = token.

calls.name: Check eligibility (EligibilityDetailsLegacy) — full 271
calls.description: Synchronous; returns PPMDResults/Results + Edi271. No AAA = active. Medicare needs the HEET attestation (UID VQAS).

calls.name: Edit address (familyupdate) — PATCH
calls.description: Captured from William's Edit-address click 9/7/2026. William's placeholder rule: HCA / SNF / ALF on line 1, zip 32308-4486.
calls.helper: patient_patch.family_address(pid, address1, address2, zip, city, state)

calls.name: gettxhistory (charges, payments, write-offs)
calls.body: <ppmdmsg action="gettxhistory" class="demographics" msgtime="{{msgtime}}" patientid="{{patientid}}" filterhistory="0" pagenumber="1" typefilter="1" sortbypayment="false" groupbyvisit="0" sortdescending="1" visitid="0" getmemo="false" nocookie="1"><usercontext>{{token}}</usercontext></ppmdmsg>

calls.name: getchargedetaildataicd10 (by charge id)
calls.description: By CHARGE id only; visitid= returns nothing for new visits. Returns ONLY the one charge asked for — see the void trap.

calls.name: addinsurance — add a plan (NO group number)
calls.body: <ppmdmsg action="addinsurance" class="demographics" msgtime="{{msgtime}}" ><usercontext>{{token}}</usercontext><patient id="pat{{patientid}}" changed="1"><insplanlist><insplan id="" begindate="{{begindate}}" carrier="car{{carrierid}}" subscriber="resp{{respid}}" subscribernum="{{membernum}}" hipaarelationship="18" relationship="1" grpname="" grpnum="" coverage="1"/></insplanlist></patient></ppmdmsg>
calls.description: Returns new ins id + sequence. William's rule (8/31): grpnum and grpname ALWAYS empty. VA member id = ICN, never SSN. Carrier ids in practices/ehpa/carriers.json.

calls.name: updateinsurance — change one plan field (wrapped shape)
calls.body: <ppmdmsg action="updateinsurance" class="demographics" msgtime="{{msgtime}}" ><usercontext>{{token}}</usercontext><patient id="pat{{patientid}}" changed="1"><insplanlist><insplan id="ins{{insid}}" enddate="{{new}}" o_enddate="{{old}}"/></insplanlist></patient></ppmdmsg>
calls.description: Send ONLY the changed field plus its o_<field> original; echoing every attribute fails 'Another user has changed this insurance record'. The bare unwrapped <insplan/> child can fault 'Value can not be null' (9/8).

calls.name: lookuppatient — find a chart
calls.description: The only patient search that works from the API. %wildcard% lookups.

calls.name: DOB / flat fields — PATCH (familyupdate null)
calls.body:
{
 "updatedpatient": "<flat patient with the changed field>",
 "originalpatient": "<the GET result, unchanged>",
 "updateaccounttype": false,
 "familyupdate": null,
 "deleteappointments": false
}
calls.description: Same PATCH as Edit address but without the familyupdate block.

calls.name: updvisitwithcharges — FULL-ECHO resave (void trap!)
calls.body: <ppmdmsg action="updvisitwithcharges" class="chargeentry" msgtime="{{msgtime}}" ><usercontext>{{token}}</usercontext><visit id="vst{{visitid}}" patient="pat{{patientid}}" insorder="{{insorder}}" refplan="{{refplan}}" preauth="{{preauth}}" facility="fac{{facilityid}}" force="1" approval="1" inspectorenabled="1" batchid=""><chargelist><charge id="charge{{chargeid}}" ...EVERY ACTIVE CHARGE OF THE VISIT, ALL ATTRIBUTES ECHOED... modcodes="mcode7"><diagcodelist><diagcode id="{{numeric dcode id}}"/></diagcodelist></charge></chargelist></visit></ppmdmsg>
calls.description: REPLACES the visit's charge list with what you send — any charge omitted is VOIDED (30 charges lost 9/2–9/3). Build from resave.visit_charges(chargeid); never echo a single-charge detail on a multi-charge visit. diagcodes= attr is silently IGNORED for edits — dx saves only via the nested <diagcodelist> child with NUMERIC ids (9/8). modcodes = mcode ids (25 = mcode7). insorder = comma list of plan SEQUENCE numbers. refplan/preauth repoint the visit to a referral plan and write the auth onto it (and onto the previous plan — process the stay keeping the original plan LAST).
calls.helper: resave.py, recode._save(cid, fn), move_to_ins.move(cid, seq), amdw.resave_visit

calls.name: updextrainsinfo — frequency reset (always original) / hospitalization dates
calls.body: <ppmdmsg action="updextrainsinfo" class="chargeentry" msgtime="{{msgtime}}" visitid="vst{{visitid}}"><usercontext>{{token}}</usercontext><extins txtChargeCode="" resubmissioncode="1" origrefnum="" hospitalizationfrom="{{admitdate}}" hospitalizationto="{{dischargedate}}"/></ppmdmsg>
calls.description: Run BEFORE every rebill: resubmissioncode=1 origrefnum='' (William 9/3 — never frequency 7 unless he hands you the payer ICN). Same call sets the hospitalization (admit) dates the Inspector wants.

calls.name: addreferralplan — one referral plan per VA stay
calls.body: <ppmdmsg action="addreferralplan" class="chargeentry" msgtime="{{msgtime}}" ><usercontext>{{token}}</usercontext><refplan id="" patient="pat{{patientid}}" ismain="0" status="stat1" preauthreq="0" sequence="2" refprov="rprov{{refprovid}}" type="I" reason="SELF-REFERRAL" preauth="" begindate="" enddate="" maxvisits="0" usedvisits="0" maxamount="" usedamount="0" proccode="" diagcodes="" facility=""/></ppmdmsg>
calls.description: Creates a BLANK plan and returns its rplan id (attribute values largely ignored). Without ismain/status it get-or-returns the existing main plan. Then resave each visit with refplan="rplanX" preauth="VAxxxx" to link + write the auth. VA auths live on referral plans, not the encounter.

calls.name: Rebill a charge (frequency 1 first via updextrainsinfo)
calls.description: HTTP 204 = queued. ALWAYS set resubmissioncode=1 origrefnum='' via updextrainsinfo first (William 9/3: every rebill is an original claim). sequencenumber = first number of the visit's insorder. Verify insbilled flips to 0.

calls.description: Bypasses the Claim Inspector edit on the charge (after the underlying fix, or when the edit is a false positive by William's rules).

calls.name: hideunbillablevisits — release Unbilled rows
calls.description: Releases (completes) Unbilled rows. 'Payment from the prior payor is required' with a days-old primary bill = release everything (9/8, 82 rows).

calls.description: Completes the exclusion run after its charges are fixed.

calls.name: addpayments — manual payment / write-off (Payment Entry)
calls.body: <ppmdmsg action="addpayments" class="paymententry" msgtime="{{msgtime}}" ><usercontext>{{token}}</usercontext><payment carrier="car{{carrierid}}" checknumber="{{checknumber}}" depositdate="{{depositdate}}" note="{{note}}"><chargelist><charge id="charge{{chargeid}}" paid="{{pay}}" writeoff="{{wo}}" writeoffcode="{{wocode}}"/></chargelist></payment></ppmdmsg>
calls.description: Posts a payment and/or write-off to one charge with a note. era_manual_post.py wraps it for an unvalidated ERA line (post the PAYMENT line, never the $0 denial line).
calls.helper: manual_post.post(cid, carrier, pay, wo, wocode, checknumber, depositdate, note)

calls.name: posterapayments — the ERA Post button (JSON ppmdmsg via wfe gateway)
calls.description: Same message with every amount "0" = Process Accepted ($0.00). Post the payment line of an unvalidated ERA, never the $0 denial line (9/6 error, fixed 9/7).

calls.name: lookupdiagcode — dcode ids
calls.body: <ppmdmsg action="lookupdiagcode" class="lookup" msgtime="{{msgtime}}" exactmatch="0" code="{{icd10}}%" orderby="code" page="1"><usercontext>{{token}}</usercontext></ppmdmsg>
calls.description: Anchor the code at the start (M86.9%); a %-prefix returns nothing. Result <diagcode id="dcodeNNN" code=...> — strip 'dcode' for the diagcodelist child.

calls.name: lookupcarrier — carrier by code
calls.description: The ONLY carrier read that works (getcarrierlist/getcarrier are invalid actions). No carrier write exists — Master Files is William's. After any carrier master edit verify the CPID stuck.

calls.name: selectfacilities — facility id map
calls.description: uid/facilityname map → practices/ehpa/facilities.json. Visit attr facility="facNN" routes facesheet lookups (PCC for SNFs).
